video_title: A Message from John Gibson | LA Clippers

quotes.speaker: John Gibson
quotes.summary_phrase: John Gibson appoints Trent Redden and Mark Hughes to interim roles
quotes.excerpt: I have appointed Trent to serve as interim president of basketball operations while Lawrence Frank is away
quotes.quote: I have appointed Trent to serve as interim president of basketball operations while Lawrence Frank is away from the team, and I have appointed Mark Hughes to serve as interim general manager.

quotes.speaker: John Gibson
quotes.summary_phrase: John Gibson reaffirms complete confidence in head coach Ty Lue
quotes.excerpt: Ty Lue remains our head coach, and we have complete confidence in his leadership
quotes.quote: Ty Lue remains our head coach, and we have complete confidence in his leadership. Ty has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to overcome adversity, unite teams, and inspire players to perform at their best. His leadership will be instrumental as we move forward.

quotes.speaker: John Gibson
quotes.summary_phrase: John Gibson addresses the trade with Toronto and new player additions
quotes.excerpt: We are excited to welcome Brandon Ingram, along with off-season additions Grady Dick, Rui Hachimura, and Max Strus
quotes.quote: We have also completed our trade with Toronto. We thank Kawhi for his contributions on the court and wish him well. At the same time, we are excited to welcome Brandon Ingram, along with off-season additions Grady Dick, Rui Hachimura, and Max Strus. They join a talented core that includes Darius Garland, Chris Dunn, Derek Jones Jr., Brook Lopez, Coby White, Isaiah Jackson, and Keaton Wallace, whom we were thrilled to select in this year's draft.
